verbatims.quote: A 0 to 100 score is a pick with extra steps. If it doesn't beat the closing line, I don't care what it combines.
ATS records and head-to-head are noise. Four books is a thin screen. I already have one with fifteen.
If the score leans on line movement, you're just echoing the market back to me with a number on it.
Free app, no picks, 'well-known betting voices'... so where's the affiliate link? Someone's getting paid.
Start Here is what I actually want. I'm not reading six tabs for a Tuesday MAC game.
I'd look at the score, sure. Trust it? Show me the weights and how it did last season.
Ask the analyst is cool if it pulls real injury news. Every AI I've tried makes up rosters.
The side-by-side bars are the easiest thing here. I can tell who's better in five seconds.

researcher_note: 'None' largest Q1 (64), mostly serious bettors with better odds screens. Score most polarizing: 103 trust-if-shown plurality, only 30 trust outright; net lowers trust (89 less vs 53 more). Start Here won Q1 among non-sharps with no trust penalty.
